nodes.label: Arité wordmark (approved logo, base version)
nodes.rationale: Approved logo that must be respected as-is; every letter is drawn from straight segments only, reading 'ArıtĒ' with a macron standing in for the accent.

nodes.label: Base variant: near-black strokes on white ground
nodes.norm_label: base variant: near-black strokes on white ground

nodes.label: Monoline straight strokes (no curves, uniform weight, square butt ends)
nodes.rationale: All glyphs are built from horizontal, vertical and one diagonal line of constant thickness; gives a technical, architectural, blueprint-like character.
nodes.norm_label: monoline straight strokes (no curves, uniform weight, square butt ends)

nodes.label: Diagonal A with extended stem (single left diagonal, right vertical stem descending well below baseline)
nodes.rationale: The A is the dominant, signature glyph: its long diagonal starts far left at baseline and its vertical stem drops below the baseline, making the mark asymmetric and recognizable.
nodes.norm_label: diagonal a with extended stem (single left diagonal, right vertical stem descending well below baseline)

nodes.label: Macron over E (detached horizontal bar replacing the acute accent of 'é')
nodes.rationale: Keeps the accent of Arité while staying within the straight orthogonal stroke system.
nodes.norm_label: macron over e (detached horizontal bar replacing the acute accent of 'e')

nodes.label: Open letterforms (E without middle arm, r as corner, strokes left unclosed)
nodes.norm_label: open letterforms (e without middle arm, r as corner, strokes left unclosed)

nodes.label: Tall t whose crossbar runs into the top arm of E (shared x-height line)
nodes.norm_label: tall t whose crossbar runs into the top arm of e (shared x-height line)

nodes.label: Shared horizontal x-height line (A crossbar, r arm, t crossbar and E top arm align)
nodes.norm_label: shared horizontal x-height line (a crossbar, r arm, t crossbar and e top arm align)

nodes.label: Base stroke weight (bold monoline, approx. 12px on a 960px canvas)
nodes.norm_label: base stroke weight (bold monoline, approx. 12px on a 960px canvas)

nodes.label: Design principle: geometric, technical minimalism (lines, right angles, generous whitespace)
nodes.rationale: Implied by the logo: a restrained, engineered look suited to a server/software brand; UI and layouts should echo thin rules, orthogonal structure and ample clear space.
nodes.norm_label: design principle: geometric, technical minimalism (lines, right angles, generous whitespace)

nodes.label: Design principle: approved logo must be respected (no redrawing, no alteration)
nodes.norm_label: design principle: approved logo must be respected (no redrawing, no alteration)

nodes.label: Logo file: 10. Hairline@2x.png (thin-stroke wordmark on off-white)
nodes.norm_label: logo file: 10. hairline@2x.png (thin-stroke wordmark on off-white)

nodes.label: Hairline wordmark variant (same geometry, very thin strokes)
nodes.rationale: Lighter, more elegant rendition of the identical construction; suited to large sizes and refined contexts where the bold base would feel heavy.
nodes.norm_label: hairline wordmark variant (same geometry, very thin strokes)

nodes.label: Hairline stroke weight (approx. 3px on a 960px canvas, about a quarter of base)
nodes.norm_label: hairline stroke weight (approx. 3px on a 960px canvas, about a quarter of base)

nodes.label: Hairline coloring: dark charcoal strokes on off-white ground (approx. #FAFAFA)
nodes.norm_label: hairline coloring: dark charcoal strokes on off-white ground (approx. #fafafa)

nodes.norm_label: logo file: 11. monograma ae@1x.png (ae monogram reversed on near-black)

nodes.label: AĒ monogram (first and last letters of the wordmark, E tucked against the A stem)
nodes.rationale: Compact mark for small or square placements (favicon, avatar, app icon) that keeps the signature diagonal A with extended stem and the macron E.
nodes.norm_label: ae monogram (first and last letters of the wordmark, e tucked against the a stem)

nodes.label: Two-tone monogram: A in white, Ē in light gray
nodes.rationale: Tonal hierarchy separates the two letters without adding a hue; the A leads, the Ē recedes.
nodes.norm_label: two-tone monogram: a in white, e in light gray

nodes.label: Design principle: use the monogram where the full wordmark does not fit
nodes.norm_label: design principle: use the monogram where the full wordmark does not fit

nodes.label: Hub-and-Spoke Topology (NAS as central hub)
nodes.rationale: The NAS is drawn largest and in the centre with every device, user and the cloud radiating from it, communicating that the home server is the single shared core of files for the whole office.

nodes.label: Anti-reference screenshot 165544: 'AI in Education' dark circuit infographic + 'TECNOLOGIA' teal icon-clutter banner
nodes.description: Two rejected template thumbnails. Left: tall dark navy 'AI in Education' infographic with glowing cyan circuit-board traces, a glowing AI brain, laptop/tech icons and a spaced futuristic display font. Right: wide 'TECNOLOGIA' presentation cover (subtitle 'Proyecto realizado por Pau Ripoll') with a rounded central title card surrounded by a clutter of flat teal tech icons (globe, chart, speech bubbles, speaker, SIM/chip, battery, gear, phone, wifi waves) on light grey.
nodes.norm_label: anti-reference screenshot 165544: 'ai in education' dark circuit infographic + 'tecnologia' teal icon-clutter banner

nodes.label: Anti-reference screenshot 165625: Canva-style grid of generic AI/tech templates
nodes.description: Template-marketplace results grid (premium crown badges, 'reallygreatsite.com' placeholders) full of rejected tech designs: 'Future Technology' banner with 3D robot mascot on blue/purple hexagon background, 'AI Chatbots' purple poster with cartoon robot, 'Ai Technology Innovation' flyer with 3D robot at a laptop, 'Proyecto de Informatica' with cyborg head and glowing brain over a particle network, neon pink/purple 'WELCOME' sign over glowing particles, 'Inteligencia Artificial' conference banner with cyan circuit lines and light streaks, 'Inteligente de la IA' with a chrome robotic hand, pastel halftone 'Presentacion de proyecto Tecnologico', and several dense dark-blue infographics (Security and Technology, Online Privacy, Inteligencia Artificial, 7 Aplicaciones de la Inteligencia Artificial).
nodes.norm_label: anti-reference screenshot 165625: canva-style grid of generic ai/tech templates

nodes.label: Anti-reference: generic commercial tech design
nodes.rationale: The 'No realizar' (do not do) folder collects designs the Arité owner explicitly rejects. Arité (home-server integral solutions + software development for SMEs) must NOT look like an interchangeable Canva-style technology template: these visuals signal generic, mass-produced 'AI/tech' marketing rather than a distinct, trustworthy brand.
